_README: Cards that exist for the playtest but are not in the workbook yet.
WRITTEN BY HAND, like rules.json and playtest_level.json. export_data.py
never overwrites it. DataDB appends these to the workbook's cards after
loading, so every existing path treats them as ordinary cards: they are
looked up the same way, dealt the same way, and a Starter-tier one joins
EVERY VALUE BELOW IS A PLACEHOLDER. When a card here earns its place it
should move into the Cards tab of the workbook and be deleted from this
file, so the workbook stays the source of truth.
The two fields the workbook computes with formulas - power_score and
power_per_cost - are left null here rather than guessed. Nothing in the
game reads them; they are the spreadsheet's own balance arithmetic.
